# Lancaster Puppies

> > Lancaster Puppies is a trusted nationwide puppy marketplace connecting buyers with AKC-registered breeders and vetted puppy listings across the United States.

Lancaster Puppies operates a comprehensive puppy marketplace featuring 15,000+ listings from certified breeders nationwide, with specialized breed categories, breeder directories, and educational pet care resources. The platform prioritizes responsible breeding through partnerships like Breedera and maintains customer support services for account setup, trust and safety, and user guidance.

## Pet Care & Education

- [Pet Advice and Information](https://www.lancasterpuppies.com/pet-advice): Pet advice hub with articles on dog care, health, training, and breed information.
- [Complete Guide to Feeding Your Puppy](https://www.lancasterpuppies.com/pet-advice/complete-guide-to-feeding-your-puppy.html): Comprehensive guide to puppy nutrition, feeding schedules, and dietary guidelines.
- [Understanding Dog Obesity: Causes, Risks & Prevention](https://www.lancasterpuppies.com/pet-advice/understanding-dog-obesity-causes-risks-prevention.html): Article on dog obesity: causes, health risks, and prevention tips for US pets.
- [Dog Owner Etiquette: Respectful Walking Tips for Safety](https://www.lancasterpuppies.com/pet-advice/dog-owner-etiquette-respectful-walking-tips-for-safety.html): Guide to dog walking etiquette, leash safety, and responsible pet ownership.
- [Breedera Joins Lancaster Puppies: Helping US Responsible Breeders](https://www.lancasterpuppies.com/pet-advice/breedera-joins-lancaster-puppies-helping-us-responsible-breeders-prioritize-what-counts.html): Article on Breedera acquisition: breeder management app for iOS and Android.
